The scored components: one registry of keys and labels

Source: R/components.R
components_registry.Rd

The scored components of a release (the seven species categories plus the environmental primprod, and the legacy v1-v7 other bucket) are named in ONE table, components.csv, read by this package, the app bundle and the docs, so a key or a label is spelled in one place. Columns: key (the sp_cat / extrisk_{key} / primprod spelling – never changes), label (the v11 display name), short, order (display order), colour (the Atlas categorical palette, --cat-* in its tokens.css; may be empty), icon (may be empty), kind ("species" or "environment") and label_v10 (the labels v1-v10 published).

Usage

components_registry(path = NULL)

Arguments

path

character; a components CSV. Default NULL reads the copy shipped in the package (system.file("extdata/components.csv", package = "msens")).

Value

a tibble of the components, sorted by order. Errors on duplicate keys or orders, a kind outside species/environment, an empty key, label, short or label_v10, or a missing column.

Details

The source of truth is workflows/data/components.csv; the copy in inst/extdata/components.csv must be identical (test-components.R compares the two when the workflows checkout sits beside this package).

Examples

components_registry()
#> # A tibble: 9 × 8
#>   key              label          short       order colour icon  kind  label_v10
#>   <chr>            <chr>          <chr>       <int> <chr>  <chr> <chr> <chr>    
#> 1 bird             Seabirds       Seabirds        1 #7cc7… ""    spec… Seabirds 
#> 2 coral            Corals         Corals          2 #f08a… ""    spec… Corals   
#> 3 fish             Fish           Fish            3 #9f81… ""    spec… Fish     
#> 4 invertebrate     Invertebrates  Inverts         4 #e79e… ""    spec… Inverteb…
#> 5 mammal           Marine Mammals Mammals         5 #e6c7… ""    spec… Marine M…
#> 6 primary_producer Flora          Flora           6 #4cc9… ""    spec… Primary …
#> 7 turtle           Sea Turtles    Turtles         7 #a1c7… ""    spec… Sea Turt…
#> 8 primprod         Productivity   Productivi…     8 #4cc9… ""    envi… Primary …
#> 9 other            Other Species  Other           9 #b6bf… ""    spec… Other Sp…
